complexity.notes: Correct but suboptimal: a min-heap of size k gives O(log k) per add, and even keeping the sorted-list approach, bisect.insort would replace the manual scan idiomatically (still O(n) for the insert shift). The unused-looking loop is fine but reinventing bisect hurts readability.
complexity.summary: Maintains the stream as a sorted list (built with sorted() in the constructor, O(n log n) once); each add() linearly scans for the insertion point, inserts val (O(n) due to list shifting), and returns stream[-k].
